Image Annotation

Image annotation is the process of labeling objects, regions, or specific features in an image to train machine learning models for computer vision tasks. It is widely used in applications such as object detection, facial recognition, autonomous driving, and medical imaging diagnostics. Common methods include drawing bounding boxes around objects, semantic segmentation (labeling each pixel in an image), polygon annotation for irregular shapes, keypoint annotation for specific points like facial landmarks, and 3D cuboids to understand the dimensions of objects in 3D space.

Comprehensive Image Annotation Services

Object Detection

Identify and label objects within images, such as vehicles, faces, or products, providing essential data for computer vision models.

Semantic Segmentation

Go beyond object identification by classifying each pixel in an image to generate detailed object and region maps, providing richer insights for analysis and understanding.

Image Classification

Categorize entire images for identification tasks, leveraging machine learning to classify images based on their content.

Precise Image Annotation: Polygon & Landmark

Polygon Annotation

Precisely outline irregular shapes in images for fine-grained object detection, enabling accurate identification of intricate objects.

Landmark Annotation
